facts.fact: MEYNG (founder Michel Wenezoui) says its SangoAI translation system for Sango, built by people rooted in Central Africa, is in production, using a frontier LLM with a 581-entry verified Sango vocabulary and native-speaker testing since launch.
MEYNG says its dataset MEYNG/sango-vocabulary, 581 verified Sango entries behind SangoAI, is described as published on Hugging Face.
